pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'bonsoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. no
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. hello, good day

2. What does 'le père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the family
   B. the grandfather
   C. the girl
   D. the father

3. What does 'le grand-père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the child
   B. the father
   C. the grandfather
   D. the grandmother

4. Read: Voici ma maison. Il y a une cuisine, un salon et deux chambres. Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Question: How many bedrooms are there? (1 mark)
   A. three
   B. two
   C. four
   D. one

5. How do you say 'On Thursday, I sing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le vendredi, je danse.
   B. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   C. Le jeudi, je chante.
   D. Une semaine, sept jours.

6. How do you say 'How old are you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tu as quel âge ?
   B. Je chante et je danse.
   C. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   D. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.

7. What number is 'six' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 16
   C. 10
   D. 17

8. What number is 'dix-neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 19
   C. 12
   D. 8

9. Fill in: C'est ______ banane. (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. une
   C. des
   D. un

10. What does 'l'orange' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the carrot
   B. tea
   C. water
   D. the orange

11. How do you say 'I do not like fish.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   B. C'est une banane.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. Je bois un jus.

12. What does 'la tête' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the tooth
   C. the mouth
   D. the neck

13. How do you say 'I have two ears.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux oreilles.
   B. J'ai dix doigts.
   C. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   D. Touche ton nez !

14. Fill in: Il y a ______ nuages. (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. des
   C. une
   D. le

15. How do you say 'It is sunny.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait beau.
   B. Il y a du soleil.
   C. Quel temps fait-il ?
   D. Il y a du vent.

16. How do you say 'Turn left.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est sur la table.
   B. Allez tout droit.
   C. Où est la clé ?
   D. Tournez à gauche.

17. What does 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is under the chair.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. Put the book in the bedroom.
   D. There is a sofa in the living room.

18. Which little word goes with 'chat' (the cat)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

19. Which little word goes with 'cou' (the neck)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. les

20. What does 'J'ai deux oreilles.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a nose.
   B. I have two ears.
   C. I have a mouth.
   D. I have ten fingers.

21. Which is friendly weather? (1 mark)
   A. l'inondation
   B. le soleil
   C. l'orage
   D. la neige et le vent fort

22. How do you say 'It is, this is' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la grand-mère
   B. la fille
   C. C'est
   D. le père

23. How do you say 'the living room' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. le ballon
   C. la cuisine
   D. la chambre

24. How do you say 'yesterday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je danse
   B. je joue
   C. demain
   D. hier

25. How do you write the number 10 in French? (1 mark)
   A. neuf
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. dix
   D. treize

26. How do you say the month 'March' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mars
   B. novembre
   C. mai
   D. octobre

27. How do you write the number 1 in French? (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. trois
   C. quinze
   D. sept

28. How do you say 'beans' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les frites
   B. la mangue
   C. le riz
   D. les haricots

29. How do you say 'long' in French? (1 mark)
   A. grand
   B. long
   C. noir
   D. court

30. How do you say 'the arm' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le bras
   B. le nez
   C. l'épaule
   D. les cheveux

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'I am well, thank you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Write a birthday card of four lines to a friend called Njeri. (4 marks) (4 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'I am nine years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Write a weather dialogue of three lines in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux pieds.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Enchanté !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

39. Translate into English: 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into French: 'Hello, Amina!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

41. Write the French words for: the hand, the back, the stomach (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I play.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Il est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'How old are you?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'Thank you very much!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'It is the first of January.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'My brother is called Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A

1. A — good evening
   bonsoir means good evening.

2. D — the father
   le père means the father.

3. C — the grandfather
   le grand-père means the grandfather.

4. B — two
   Deux chambres.

5. C — Le jeudi, je chante.
   On Thursday, I sing. in French is Le jeudi, je chante.

6. A — Tu as quel âge ?
   How old are you? in French is Tu as quel âge ?

7. A — 6
   six means 6.

8. B — 19
   dix-neuf means 19.

9. B — une
   Banane is feminine.

10. D — the orange
   l'orange means the orange.

11. A — Je n'aime pas le poisson.

12. A — the head
   la tête means the head.

   I have two ears. in French is J'ai deux oreilles.

14. B — des
   Des is used for many things.

   It is sunny. in French is Il y a du soleil.

16. D — Tournez à gauche.
   Turn left. in French is Tournez à gauche.

17. C — Put the book in the bedroom.
   Mets le livre dans la chambre. means Put the book in the bedroom.

18. B — le
   chat is masculine, so we say le chat.

19. A — le
   cou is masculine, so we say le cou.

20. B — I have two ears.
   J'ai deux oreilles. means I have two ears.

21. B — le soleil
   Sun is pleasant weather.

22. C — C'est

23. A — le salon

24. D — hier

25. C — dix

26. A — mars

27. A — un

28. D — les haricots

29. B — long
